title: Affine smooth trait neighborhoods and their principal generic open
statement: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field $K$ as an $A$-algebra. Fix an irreducible element $\pi\in A$ (a uniformizer). Let $d:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and $x\in L$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put $b:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $i:L_K\to L$ for the generic-fibre projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist a commutative ring $R$, an etale morphism $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}R\to L$, and a point $y$ with $\varphi(y)=x$, together with an $A$-algebra structure on $R$ for which $R$ is smooth over $A$. If $D=D(\operatorname{algebraMap}_{A,R}(\pi))\subset\operatorname{Spec}R$, there is an isomorphism $\beta:L_K\times_L\operatorname{Spec}R\simeq D$ such that $\beta;\iota_D=\operatorname{pr}_2$. All rings and schemes lie in one universe. No group or torsor occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Show K is the localization of A at powers of pi. For a fraction r/s, express its nonzero denominator as a unit times a power of pi using IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible. Multiply the numerator by the inverse unit. Injectivity of the fraction-ring map proves the localization equality condition. This is the proved private helper fractionRing_away_uniformizer.

Choose an affine open V containing x by Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Set R to the ring of sections and phi to IsAffineOpen.fromSpec. The affine isomorphism gives y mapping to x. The A-algebra structure is induced by Spec.preimage of phi followed by d. HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and smooth composition give Algebra.Smooth A R.

The localization map b is an open immersion with range D(pi). Both successive pullbacks are open immersions. Mathlib range_pullbackSnd and opensRange_pullbackFst identify the range of their composite pullback projection with the inverse image of D(pi), which is D(pi_R) by PrimeSpectrum.comap_basicOpen. IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq gives beta and isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac proves the compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem smooth_trait_affine_generic_open
    (A K : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (π : A) (hπ : Irreducible π)
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (d : L ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [Smooth d] (x : L) :
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K))
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (y : Spec R),
      Etale φ ∧ φ y = x ∧
      ∃ _a : Algebra A R, Algebra.Smooth A R ∧
        let D : (Spec R).Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap A R π)
        ∃ β : pullback (pullback.fst d b) φ ≅ D.toScheme,
          β.hom ≫ D.ι = pullback.snd (pullback.fst d b) φ
